head: iPhone 20 Pro design rumors: iPhone Air glass curved on all four sides
dek: Leaker Fixed Focus Digital says next year's iPhone 20 Pro will use the iPhone Air's glass, curved more strongly on all four sides. Apple hasn't confirmed the design or the name.
details: A drawing shared with the post shows rounded glass on the front and back meeting a thin frame. MacRumors says Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has also described glass that curves into the sides with a thin metal band between the panels and thinner bezels. The models are expected in fall 2027, and the iPhone 20 name comes from leakers.
means: If you're planning a new iPhone for 2027, the Pro models may look quite different from today's.
todo: Nothing to do; this is an early rumor.
